notes: Global design tokens and motion bar: one transition default (120 ms on the settle curve) and an --ease-out custom property replace every easing keyword and the 0.22 bezier in index.css; a .pressable class and a global focus-visible ring; Button presses to 0.96 with no hover scale and a 400 ms ripple; StatefulButton crossfades its label in a stable footprint instead of a per-letter blur cascade; ENTER preset in ease.ts; z-fade-in is a 150 ms opacity-only fade; z-pop-in, z-rise-in, Collapse and TabsContent deleted; TweenHeight ignores nested transitionend events; raw palette colours become success/warning/danger/info tokens, half-pixel text sizes and off-scale opacities land on the ladder, bare rounded/rounded-sm become rounded-md, stroke widths normalise to 1.75, cursor-not-allowed becomes cursor-default, and animate-pulse/spin gate behind motion-safe
